title: Repo execution truth stays repo-local
prompt: Use create-jarvis-skill to scaffold a pilot for a fictional company with one frontend repo and one API repo. The user provides build/test commands for each repo. Generate the central JARVIS and skill backlog. Do not put detailed repo execution manuals into central JARVIS; route them to repo-local skill stubs.

forbidden_patterns: central JARVIS owns all build commands
copy all repo instructions into central
